response.answer: Adenosine A2A receptor signaling in the choroid plexus is linked to CSF hypersecretion and ventriculomegaly in hydrocephalus. Caffeine administration can modulate this signaling. Genetic factors, like SFMBT1 gene mutations, also influence choroid plexus function and hydrocephalus.
